capabilities.name: tag.context.overview
capabilities.use: Confirm the nexus, the caller's role and that TAG is invited.

capabilities.name: tag.ledger.transactions.read
capabilities.use: GL and subledger detail for matching.

capabilities.name: tag.ledger.bank_statement.read
capabilities.use: Bank statement lines for bank reconciliations.

capabilities.name: tag.policy.reporting.read
capabilities.use: Materiality, escalation thresholds and aging buckets.

capabilities.name: aletia.search
capabilities.use: Prior reconciliations, counterparty confirmations and support.

capabilities.name: tag.evidence.attach
capabilities.use: Record sources and the workpaper against the run.

capabilities.name: tag.review.request
capabilities.use: Route the reconciliation to its reviewer.

inputs.name: GL balance and detail
inputs.source: tag.ledger.trial_balance.read and tag.ledger.transactions.read, or a ledger export

inputs.name: independent source balance and detail (bank, subledger, control account, counterparty)
inputs.source: tag.ledger.bank_statement.read, tag.ledger.transactions.read, or documents the user supplies

outputs.name: reconciliation workpaper
outputs.description: Balances, categorized and aged reconciling items, unreconciled difference, escalations, review status.

outputs.name: proposed adjusting entries
outputs.description: Drafts handed to finance-journal-entry-prep; never posted.

conditions: Reconciling items that are stale, recurring or above the organization's escalation thresholds.
Where the organization requires a reviewer other than the preparer.
Before proposed adjusting entries go to finance-journal-entry-prep for approval.
